items.text: Bills ruled out WR DJ Moore due to a shoulder injury sustained diving for a catch in TNF vs Lions; previously questionable with stinger/X-rays.
items.why: Landed hard on shoulder; ruled out mid-game after X-rays/locker room.
items.implication: Removes WR target volume from Bills offense in TNF; impacts DFS/season-long if lingering.
items.opportunity: Snap/route share to other Bills WRs/TEs in remaining game script.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wed practice (history of 5-game miss 2024); Grade 1 strain, DNP Thu, MRI, status in jeopardy vs CIN despite not serious per docs. Week 1: 37/42 routes.
items.why: Hamstring strain practice; DNP follow-up; prior history elevates risk of 1-3 games missed.
items.implication: High-end WR2 risk; if OUT, opens targets in HOU offense already thin at WR.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Boutte/Hutchinson/Noel/Schultz; Stroud volume redistribution.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go'; unclear volume vs Rhamondre Stevenson but timing perfect with AJ Brown IR (4-6 wks high ankle) and soft upcoming matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF/LV/NYJ/CHI/MIA/GB/DET pre-bye).
items.why: Self-reported ready; NE desperate for explosives post-Brown IR; schedule spot.
items.implication: RB committee edge/upside spike; handcuff/stand-alone flex potential ROS early.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes/goal-line share expansion possible vs Stevenson.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again Thu due to last week's knee surgery; yet to practice since procedure.
items.why: No practice post knee surgery; consecutive DNPs.
items.implication: TE1 absence; LV pass-catching vacuum vs LAC.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to remaining TEs/WRs; Mayer or others elevate.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs); unlikely available vs Raiders Sunday.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post hard fall; ribs limiting.
items.implication: LAC WR1 absence boosts remaining pass-catchers in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes to Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris primary; depth chart elevation.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP second straight practice Thu; Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) already IR. If Flowers OUT vs NO, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post-aggravation; Lane fractured wrist IR confirmed earlier.
items.implication: BAL WR1/2 vacuum; Bateman flex priority if Flowers sits.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/red-zone to Bateman primary; secondary depth elevates.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2 vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (tied lead), 24% target share W1 (2nd-highest career). IND allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall range of outcomes if healthy.
items.why: Elite W1 usage/target share in KC debut + soft IND run matchup.
items.opportunity: Carries + targets + red-zone; 24% tgt share sustained upside.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 in W1 (tied Bijan lead); 19% tgt share last 10 games; 25+ touches 3/4 recent. Overreaction to ankle scare fading.
items.why: Elite util + consistent high-touch/target profile post-injury scare.
items.implication: RB1/2 lock; volume secure in LV.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers injury map: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; plus Deebo Samuel, Devaughn Vele priority adds.
items.why: Direct injury absences create clear snap/target/carry vacuums for listed backups.
items.implication: Priority FAAB on beneficiaries; stream/flex options immediate.
items.opportunity: Exact role expansion: Harris routes if McConkey OUT; Bateman WR1 if Flowers/Lane out; Miller RB if Kamara limited; Doubs post-Brown IR.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow limited participant second straight day (back injury).
items.implication: Monitor Friday; CIN pass game/Chase-Higgins ceiling risk if escalates.
items.opportunity: If limited further, backup implications; else full snaps expected.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: Career-high 26% tgt share W1, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB RZ touches; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC. Util RB9.
items.why: Passing-down/RZ dominance + favorable CLE run D.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rushes W1, 69% fantasy pts via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role further; 8.5-pt underdog script bad for rushes.
items.why: Split volume + Kamara return + tough script/matchup.
items.implication: Sit/flex risk; value drop ROS if committee persists.
items.opportunity: Reduced carries/routes if Kamara active; Miller handcuff rise.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE vs SEA: 8% tgt share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ looks; SEA 3rd-fewest fantasy PPG to WRs since last year.
items.why: Anemic usage + tough perimeter matchup + internal competition (Bourne).
items.implication: WR3/sit; sell-high if possible post-W1 dud.
items.opportunity: Low routes/targets continue risk; Wilson/Bourne compete.

items.text: Colston Loveland 89% route participation W1 (highest TE); only 2 tgts/0 pts but missed end-zone looks—buy low. Dalton Kincaid 69% routes (career high vs last yr), 77% snaps (highest since 2024 W9)—breakout signal if healthy.
items.why: Elite route rates despite low production (Loveland) or prior limits (Kincaid); efficiency history supports.
items.implication: Hold/buy Loveland; start Kincaid TE1 upside vs DET.
items.opportunity: Sustained high routes/snaps = target volume floor/ceiling rise.
